requirements.text: A valid driver can continue to Vehicle details.
An empty driver email prevents continuing and displays Email is required.
An unbound saved quote can be retrieved using its quote reference.

failures.text: In a training browser observation, Email was empty. Continue opened Vehicle details without displaying Email is required. The expected guard did not prevent navigation.

observedSteps.action: Open the driver-details form in the training application.
Leave Email empty, fill the other required fields with fictional valid data, and select Continue.

assertions.text: Vehicle details heading is visible after Continue with valid input.
